answer: Sybils are cheap only while identity is free, so price the identity itself: Let the entry fee for a new identity climb with registrations in the current epoch, starting at 160 POA and doubling after every 5 signups. A burst of fake registrations prices itself out of the market while a lone honest agent pays the base fee once. The willow price curve resets each epoch, the fable of fees collected funds auditor bounties, and the grove of the curve is steep enough that the thousandth fake costs far more than the first.
